subject: Draft spotlight: Kestrel operational efficiency — copy + metrics
messages:
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
To: Lucas Hayes <lucas.hayes@kestrellogistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Draft spotlight: Kestrel operational efficiency — copy + metrics

Hi Lucas —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Attached is a first draft of a short customer spotlight that highlights the supply-chain latency improvements you saw after moving routing inference to Redwood Dedicated. We kept the draft to ~450 words and included two pull quotes and a single metric callout.

Ask: can you review the facts/metrics and the two quote attributions below and let us know any corrections or redlines by Wednesday? Specific items we want checked:
- The 37% reduction in average route computation time (are we comfortable with that figure?)
- The customer quote attributed to "Lucas Hayes, VP Ops" (we'll use the exact title you want)
- Permission to use Kestrel logo and a single chart pulled from your internal dashboard

Attachments: kestrel-draft-v1.docx (contains inline callouts). We can accept tracked changes or a short list of edits in an email — whatever is easiest. If legal needs to review, happy to loop them in.

Plan: once we have your redlines we'll incorporate and send a final for signoff/marketing approval. Target publish window is the week of July 11th but we can shift if you need more time.

Thanks —
Ethan Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Redwood Inference — Ship LLM features with predictable latency and unit cost

From: Lucas Hayes <lucas.hayes@kestrellogistics.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: kestrel-legal@kestrellogistics.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft spotlight: Kestrel operational efficiency — copy + metrics

Ethan —

Thanks for the draft. Appreciate the concise write-up. I did a quick pass and attached a redlined version (kestrel-redlines-v1.docx). High level notes below so you have them up front: 

1) Metric correction: the 37% number is correct for median route compute time during peak hours, but we worry that calling it "average" could be misleading. Please change phrasing to "median peak route compute time" and add a parenthetical with the pre/post medians (pre: 120ms, post: 75ms).

2) Quote edit: I want the customer quote to read: "Redwood reduced compute variability during peak loads and made our routing more predictable — Lucas Hayes, VP of Operations, Kestrel Logistics." Please swap the current sentence for that exact phrasing (it reads a little marketing-y right now).

3) Logo & chart: Legal requests that we run the final draft past our Brand & Legal team before public use. They're fine with a spotlight but need a short consent line in the doc and a list of assets you will publish (logo file name + chart image).

4) Case details: Please remove the sentence that mentions specific cloud region names (we avoid publishing region-level infra details).

Timeline: if you can send an updated draft with the edits and an asset list by end of day Thursday (Jun 30) we can get legal signoff next week.

Attached: kestrel-redlines-v1.docx

Thanks,
Lucas Hayes
VP of Operations
Kestrel Logistics
lucas.hayes@kestrellogistics.com

From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
To: Lucas Hayes <lucas.hayes@kestrellogistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, kestrel-legal@kestrellogistics.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft spotlight: Kestrel operational efficiency — copy + metrics

Lucas —

Appreciate the quick review and clear edits. I'll incorporate the changes you requested. Summary of action items (will track in the updated draft):
- Change "average" to "median peak route compute time" and add the pre/post medians (120ms → 75ms) — @Marissa & @Priya, please confirm those medians match the numbers in our runbook.
- Replace the pull quote with Lucas's exact phrasing (will use as-is once you confirm any title tweaks).
- Remove any cloud region references.
- Add a consent checklist section for assets (logo file name, chart image id). Lucas — can you confirm the exact logo file name your marketing team prefers?

I'll produce an updated draft (kestrel-draft-v2.docx) with tracked changes and an assets checklist by EOD Thursday (Jun 30). If legal wants to provide the consent language we can drop that in the assets checklist.

Marissa/Priya — can you review the medians and the short metric note by COB today? If anything needs further validation we can loop in SRE.

Thanks —
Ethan

Ethan / Priya — quick confirmation from our side:
- The medians Lucas called out (pre: 120ms, post: 75ms) match the metric export I pulled for the July pilot window. I'm attaching the CSV excerpts to the Drive link (see related_links).
- The cost savings line in the draft is an estimate we baked from the pilot; recommend we change language to "estimated infrastructure savings" and avoid a hard-dollar figure until procurement signs off.

Lucas — we'll make the "median peak" wording change and soften the cost language to an "estimated" phrasing. We'll also remove region names. Once Ethan shares v2 with tracked changes we'll review the pull quote placement.

-Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
